EO 9161 (May 13, 1942, Franklin D. Roosevelt), titled Revoking Executive Order No. 8975 of December 13, 1941, read in full in the registered American Presidency Project transcription (jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-9161-revoking-executive-order-no-8975-december-13-1941.txt; grade mirror_transcription, acceptable_as_original false; standing note: original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved). Page check per jobs/claim-kit/AGENT_PROTOCOL.md, done 2026-11-04: the page record with the same sha256 in the APP mirror records (capture archive common-crawl) has the heading Executive Order 9161—Revoking Executive Order No. 8975 of December 13, 1941, date 1942-05-13, and a text_sha256 equal to the held file's. The held text's date line (May 13, 1942) agrees with the APP page record and the register. The order has one operative command: under the Civil Service Act (22 Stat. 403) it revokes Executive Order No. 8975 of December 13, 1941, which authorized the Attorney General to make appointments in the Alien Property Division, Department of Justice, without regard to the requirements of the Civil Service Act and Rules. First end: the revocation operated when the order was issued, so the command was exhausted by performance on 1942-05-13; the text states no deferred effective date.
